budget.description: Exclude write I/O bytes and write-buffer capacity from poll byte accounting; retain default operation/record budgets.

index.description: Use a single Entry lookup on publication; reserve a conservative entries.len() upper bound without an index scan when within the hard limit. Keep exact deduplication near the limit.

sync.description: Diagnostic only: synchronously call sync_data for Sync requests inside UringQueue and return a queued completion. All persistence barriers remain; owner nonblocking behavior is deliberately lost.

wide.description: The budget variant plus an operations budget of 512 instead of 64.

entryalloc.description: Only replace try_reserve_exact(count) by try_reserve(count.max(4)) for pending index-entry vectors.

process_environment_ablation.binaries: Identical original baseline/candidate hashes; environment affects only each launched child.

profiling.instrumentation: Phase CLOCK_MONOTONIC and thread CPU clocks, poll/admission/rejection counts; perf cycles:u at 499 Hz, DWARF callchains. Original binaries profiled separately at 999 Hz using an external stdout timestamp.
